step3_patient_anchor.coreference_notes: A 40-year-old male with HIV infection on combination ART presenting with bilateral sensorineural hearing loss and skin lesions diagnosed as otosyphilis and malignant secondary syphilis

step5_concept_grounding: Documented HIV infection with baseline CD4 count of 247 cells/muL managed with tenofovir, lamivudine, and dolutegravir combination antiretroviral therapy

evidence_items.source_quote: diagnosed to have HIV the following month in a nearby hospital with a CD4 count of 247 cells/muL.
Daily antiretroviral (ARV) therapy was given subsequently with a combination of tenofovir, lamivudine, and dolutegravir.

rationale: A 40-year-old male presented with a 2-week history of bilateral sensorineural hearing loss and crusted ulcerative skin lesions. History documented recent weight loss and chronic diarrhea leading to an HIV diagnosis at a regional hospital with a CD4 count of 247 cells/muL, for which he was initiated on tenofovir, lamivudine, and dolutegravir. Dermatologic and serologic evaluations confirmed secondary malignant syphilis and otosyphilis, which responded to ceftriaxone. Confirmed HIV infection on active combination ART satisfies diagnostic criteria -> POSITIVE.

step3_patient_anchor.coreference_notes: A woman in her mid-fifties with known HIV infection and poorly controlled diabetes mellitus presenting with confusion, DKA, sepsis, and pneumorrhachis

step5_concept_grounding: Known HIV infection with advanced immunodeficiency manifested by a CD4 count of 89 cells/mm3

evidence_items.source_quote: She had known HIV infection and poorly controlled diabetes mellitus.
Her CD4 count was 89, and HbA1c was 15.4%.

rationale: A woman in her mid-fifties presented with acute confusion, weakness, neck stiffness, and sepsis complicated by DKA and pneumorrhachis. She had a known history of HIV infection with severe immunodeficiency documented by a CD4 count of 89 cells/mm3 (meeting CDC AIDS defining criteria). Known HIV infection with profound CD4 lymphopenia confirms active disease -> POSITIVE.

step3_patient_anchor.coreference_notes: A 43-year-old male presenting with fever and abdominal pain, newly diagnosed with HIV-1 infection complicated by concurrent amoebic and Salmonella liver abscesses

step5_concept_grounding: Newly diagnosed HIV infection confirmed by CDC confirmatory testing, with a CD4 count of 163.4 cells/muL and plasma viral load of 153,270 copies/mL

evidence_items.source_quote: Laboratory results revealed a positive HIV antibody test, the Jiaxing Municipal Center for Disease Control and Prevention (Jiaxing CDC: responsible for disease surveillance and public health management at the municipal level) confirmed the positive result, further laboratory tests revealed a CD4 count (163.4 cells/muL, reference range, 324.60-1274.70 cells/muL) and viral load (153,270 copies/mL, reference range, < 20 copies/mL).
evidence_items.test_name: Confirmatory HIV testing, viral load, and CD4 count

rationale: A 43-year-old male presented with high fever and right upper quadrant abdominal pain caused by ruptured hepatic abscesses involving Entamoeba histolytica and Salmonella enterica serotypes Typhi and Typhimurium. Immunologic workup demonstrated newly diagnosed HIV infection confirmed by the municipal CDC, with an elevated viral load of 153,270 copies/mL and marked CD4 depletion to 163.4 cells/muL. Laboratory-confirmed HIV with high-level viremia and opportunistic multi-pathogen liver abscesses satisfies all confirmatory criteria -> POSITIVE.

step3_patient_anchor.coreference_notes: A 55-year-old male with HIV on Biktarvy and nonischemic cardiomyopathy presenting with purulent bacterial pericarditis and impending tamponade

step5_concept_grounding: Documented chronic HIV infection well-managed on Biktarvy combination antiretroviral therapy with CD4 count of 254 cells/muL and viral load of 32 copies/mL

evidence_items.source_quote: HIV compliant with combination ART bictegravir, emtricitabine, and tenofovir alafenamide (Biktarvy)
The patient's laboratory analysis revealed a CD4 count of 254 cells/muL with an HIV viral load of 32 copies/mL.
evidence_items.test_name: HIV viral load and CD4 count
evidence_items.target_concept: HIV viral load and CD4 count

rationale: A 55-year-old male with well-controlled HIV infection on Biktarvy (bictegravir, emtricitabine, and tenofovir alafenamide) and cardiomyopathy presented with severe acute chest pain and dyspnea, diagnosed with purulent Streptococcus pneumoniae pericarditis and impending cardiac tamponade. Routine laboratory evaluation showed excellent virologic control with an HIV viral load of 32 copies/mL and CD4 count of 254 cells/muL. Documented HIV infection with laboratory quantitation on ART fulfills criteria -> POSITIVE.

step3_patient_anchor.coreference_notes: A 57-year-old man presenting after a first tonic-clonic seizure, found to have a benign dysembryoplastic neuroepithelial tumor (DNET) and newly diagnosed HIV-1 infection

step5_concept_grounding: Newly diagnosed HIV-1 infection confirmed by positive antibody test, plasma viral load of 2,493 copies/mL, and CD4+ T-cell count of 369 cells/microL, treated with dolutegravir and lamivudine

evidence_items.source_quote: The initial laboratory evaluation yielded a positive HIV antibody test result and mildly elevated C-reactive protein levels (17 mg/L; normal range: <5 mg/L), but no leukocytosis.
An immunovirological evaluation revealed an HIV-1 infection, with a plasma viral load of 2,493 copies/mL and a CD4+ T-cell count of 369 cells/microL (normal range: 700-1100 cells/microL).
evidence_items.test_name: HIV-1 viral load and CD4+ count
evidence_items.target_concept: HIV-1 RNA and CD4 T-cell count

evidence_items.source_quote: The patient was initiated on antiretroviral therapy with dolutegravir and lamivudine, which was well tolerated.

rationale: A 57-year-old man presenting with generalized tonic-clonic seizures and a temporal lobe mass was initially screened for opportunistic infections and found to be positive on HIV antibody testing. Confirmatory immunovirological evaluation established HIV-1 infection with a viral load of 2,493 copies/mL and CD4+ T-cell count of 369 cells/microL, prompting initiation of dolutegravir and lamivudine ART. The brain lesion was confirmed as a benign dysembryoplastic neuroepithelial tumor (DNET). Confirmatory viral load and serology definitively substantiate HIV-1 infection -> POSITIVE.

step3_patient_anchor.coreference_notes: A 32-year-old pregnant woman at 21 weeks gestation with congenital HIV/AIDS and profound immunosuppression presenting with severe dysphagia due to idiopathic esophageal ulcers

step5_concept_grounding: Congenital HIV/AIDS with profound CD4 lymphopenia (CD4 count 4 cells/mm3) and high viremia (HIV RNA 96,000 copies/mL) presenting with HIV-associated idiopathic esophageal ulceration

evidence_items.source_quote: Her medical history included congenital HIV/AIDS with a history of prolonged nonadherence to antiretroviral therapy (ART), and she was on nifedipine.
Laboratory evaluation revealed profound immunosuppression with a CD4 count of 4 cells/mm3 and an HIV viral load of 96,000 copies/mL.
evidence_items.test_name: HIV viral load and CD4 count
evidence_items.target_concept: HIV viral load and CD4 cell count

evidence_items.source_quote: Based on the clinical presentation, endoscopic findings, severe immunosuppression, and exclusion of infectious causes, a diagnosis of HIV-associated IEU was made.
evidence_items.test_name: Diagnosis of HIV-associated idiopathic esophageal ulceration

rationale: A 32-year-old pregnant woman with congenital HIV/AIDS and history of prolonged nonadherence presented with progressive dysphagia and severe cachexia. Laboratory testing demonstrated late-stage AIDS with near-total CD4 depletion (4 cells/mm3) and an HIV viral load of 96,000 copies/mL. Endoscopy and biopsy excluded opportunistic pathogens (CMV, HSV, Candida, AFB) and confirmed HIV-associated idiopathic esophageal ulceration. Resumption of ART led to clinical resolution. Confirmatory viral load, profound immunosuppression, and direct HIV complication satisfy criteria for POSITIVE -> POSITIVE.
